issues.detail: The Greek 'τι ερειτε' is a question ('what will you say?'), not an imperative command to answer. The Vietnamese 'hãy trả lời' (please/must answer) changes the grammatical mood from an interrogative to an imperative.

The Greek 'ευθεως δε αποστελει αυτους' means 'He will NOT send them immediately' (the 'δε' is a negation). The Vietnamese translation 'Ngài sẽ gửi chúng đến ngay' omits the negation, completely reversing the meaning of the sentence.
